2661-3859-8122.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost.
Because Cavern Harpy will have 5 power due to The Muckslinger Gang, Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand. 
Repeat.

131-3363.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
During your next upkeep, return The One Ring to your hand using Umbilicus.
Repeat each turn.

1170-5131-5705-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5705-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
1170-5131-5705-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

880-3470-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5359-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

1912-4050-7195-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing two counters from it, returning Chaos Spewer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Chaos Spewer enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Chaos Spewer, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

903-1984-2199.notablePrerequisites: Karplusan Minotaur has indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
903-1984-2199.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to Angel's Grace, and Karplusan Minotaur cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 3.

252-1575-2034-5776.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Repeat.
252-1575-2034-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

333-2281-5686.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1061-1879-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-1879-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-1879-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

2281-2921-3817.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1894-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5220-5231-6594.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-6594.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2231-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
2231-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1089-3693-6822.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

1636-1722-2708-6625.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1636-1722-2708-6625.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Sigiled Starfish by tapping it, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2506-2721-5686.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

38-659-5090.easyPrerequisites: Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
38-659-5090.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Goblins.
38-659-5090.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

4452-4508-5491-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure and Map token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

618-3991-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

864-1987-2103-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
864-1987-2103-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

3140-3769-6085.notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3140-3769-6085.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1071-3158-4047-5109.notablePrerequisites: Rhox Faithmender phased out by Oubliette.
1071-3158-4047-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Rhox Faithmender to phase in as Oubliette leaves the battlefield, and causing you to gain life equal to twice the amount of damage dealt to you plus 40.

939-2499-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2668-2689-5231.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a greater life total than you.
2668-2689-5231.description:
Cast Pulse of the Forge by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting an opponent that has more life than you.
Resolve Pulse of the Forge, creating four 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility, and returning Pulse of the Forge to your hand.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Elemental Shamans, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3129-3750-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
3129-3750-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least three life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

985-3446-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1348-3814.notablePrerequisites:
You control any other mana-producing land.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1348-3814.description:
Attack with Argothian Elder.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and preventing all combat damage that would be dealt to and by it this turn.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and any other land.
Activate that land by tapping it to add mana.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-3554-4105.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Demonic Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Demonic Tutor and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

643-656-1374.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant dies as a state based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat.
